purpose: L3 full-stack property test: assertS5 is the invariant check that member-iff-leaf holds for groupIdA. S1 replaces the positive-only body with the full biconditional using model flags as truth and leafIndexesFor(...).length as the observable.

public_api.name: assertS5
public_api.signature: async function assertS5(m: ModelState, r: RealSystem): Promise<void>
public_api.description: For each (pubkey, isMember) in [(m.pubkeyA, m.memberA), (m.pubkeyB, m.memberB)]: if isMember === true asserts leafCount(m.groupIdA, pubkey) >= 1; if isMember === false asserts leafCount(m.groupIdA, pubkey) === 0. Returns without throwing when m.groupIdA is null or a pubkey is null. Scoped to m.groupIdA only — cross-run leftover leaves in older groups are not observed.

test_targets: AC-S5-1: biconditional in both directions via model flags
AC-S5-3: early-return on null groupIdA or null pubkey
AC-S5-4: deliberate mismatch causes failure (manual verification, then reverted)
